text: The prosecutor general of the Republic (Portuguese: procurador-geral da República) serves as the head of the Brazilian Federal Prosecution Office, an autonomous body responsible for criminal prosecution and the protection of society at large. This official leads a team of independent prosecutors (Procuradores da República) who conduct investigations and prosecute criminal, labor, and civil offenses against society. The position is appointed by the president of the Republic and requires approval from the Federal Senate. Paulo Gustavo Gonet Branco has held the office of prosecutor general of Brazil since 18 December 2023.
